name: orbitwrite
description: Plan, draft, schedule and publish social posts through your Orbitwrite workspace on X, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and Discord. Bundles the orbitwrite skill and the hosted Orbitwrite MCP server.

orbitwrite.description: Hosted Orbitwrite MCP server (streamable HTTP). Authenticates with the workspace API key you enter at install.

settings.name: Orbitwrite API key
settings.description: A workspace API key (orbit_sk_...) from Settings, then API keys in the Orbitwrite app.
